question: Under the proposed National Building Research Institute law, how long does an employee have to decide whether to decline the offered position after being notified?
answer:

question: Under the amended Rubber Control Act, who is defined as the “Director‑General”?
answer:
The amended Act defines “Director-General” as the Director-General of the Rubber Development Department appointed or deemed appointed under the Act.

* “‘Director-General’ means the Director-General of the Rubber Development Department, appointed or deemed to have been appointed under this Act;” [494/2024 §6]

question: Under the proposed amendment to the Judicature Act, how are the retirement ages for judges and magistrates being changed?
answer:
The amendment to s.6 of the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978 raises the retirement age for certain judges and sets a uniform age for other judges and magistrates.

* Subsection (3) is amended by substituting “sixty-three years” for “sixty-one years” [058/2026 §3].
* Subsection (4) is substituted to provide: “Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Public and Judicial Officers (Retirement) Ordinance (Chapter 355), the age of retirement of all other Judges and Magistrates shall be sixty-two years.” [058/2026 §3]

The Bill description summarises the change as judges may now serve until 63 instead of 61, and all other judges and magistrates must retire at 62, overriding the Public and Judicial Officers (Retirement) Ordinance [064/2026].
